meta.title: Tidal Clock
meta.words: v3: the glass pad is back (you missed it), but moving: pumping with the kick, its filter breathing on a slow LFO, its voicing shifting every eight bars; the woodblocks and toms are now native (a block's real modes, struck skins), and rain falls through the breakdown; otherwise as v2. v2, from your notes: no clap (toms and rim off the downbeats instead); the two kalimba loops vary a little every few phrases, each with its own filter opening and closing on an LFO that speeds up, resonance and echo washes; the breakdown is woodblocks in sevens in echoes and reverb, then the hats build it back up.
